ftp.label: 255W
ftp.note: Reference power only — the plan explicitly does not treat FTP as a hard gate. Race readiness is judged primarily by 22km TT time, sustainable aero power, and brick performance.

vo2.label: 52 mL/kg/min
vo2.note: Estimated target for an amateur male, age 40–44, aiming for a sub-1:00 sprint triathlon. Based on a study of amateur Olympic-distance triathletes (mean age 42.1y) with measured VO2max 54.0±5.1 mL/kg/min, and general fitness-chart guidance that trained men in their 40s sit in a ~48–55+ mL/kg/min ‘good-to-excellent’ band. No test on file yet.

bodyweight.label: 155 lb
bodyweight.note: Per plan §17, body weight is treated as a dependent variable, not a hard requirement — shown here as a personal target only.
